questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Haplorchis taichui?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Eggs in stool; recovered adults or molecular material for species confirmation.
questions.explanation: Eggs in stool; recovered adults or molecular material for species confirmation. Wet mount/concentration at about 400× identifies small-fluke eggs.

references.title: Published Haplorchis egg morphology and size variation
